reason: The trigger is real but outside the window: VoltaGrid announced the $1.0B strategic equity investment from Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and Halliburton ($775M primary, $225M secondary) and the definitive agreement to acquire Propell Energy Technology on 11 May 2026 (GlobeNewswire, company newsroom, Blackstone), 117 days before the row's date against a 90-day limit. The release said both transactions were expected to close in mid-2026, but no closing announcement was found on the company newsroom, GlobeNewswire or Blackstone as of 6 Sep 2026, and no other company announcement falls inside the window: the Oracle 2.3 GW agreement dates from 15 Oct 2025 (POWER, DCD), the $5.0B financing package from November 2025 (company newsroom), and the ABB collaboration extension from March 2026. Not contradicted, not an existing F1/FE partner. Also noted for the human layer: Oracle, VoltaGrid's anchor customer, is title partner of Oracle Red Bull Racing, and ABB, its automation partner, is Formula E's title partner — adjacency to record, not a signal on its own. Re-open on the closing of the Blackstone/Halliburton investment and the Propell acquisition (the row's decision-maker, Nathan Ough, Co-Founder & CEO, stands), when a Houston behind-the-meter power company with a ~7.5 GW order book is a genuine F1-side capacity story around the United States GP.
